{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bothan Trade Mission''' was an organization that officially dealt with [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] trade interests throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Koth Melan]] was officially an [[assistant consul general]] of the Trade Mission, which was an intricate cover for his true work as [[Spymaster/Legends|spymaster]] of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]].

At some point around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Garin]] and [[Sharalon]] had an impromptu meeting after a Bothan Trade Mission reception.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Weekly Luncheon|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
